entities.name: Ssu72 phosphatase
observations: The 262-residue query sequence is an exact sequence match to reviewed Aspergillus oryzae Ssu72 (UniProt Q2UPU5).
Pfam scanning identifies the Ssu72 domain PF04722.19 at residues 28–261.
Ssu72 is a nuclear RNA polymerase II C-terminal-domain phosphatase and a component of the cleavage and polyadenylation factor complex.

entities.name: Protein Ser/Thr dephosphorylation
observations: Hydrolyzes protein O-phosphoserine and O-phosphothreonine bonds using water, producing the unphosphorylated residue and inorganic phosphate.
For Ssu72, the biologically emphasized substrate is Ser-5 in the RNA polymerase II CTD heptad repeat YSPTSPS.

entities.name: RNA polymerase II CTD
observations: Ssu72 processively dephosphorylates Ser-5 of the YSPTSPS heptad repeats in the largest RNA polymerase II subunit.
This activity contributes to transcription termination and mRNA 3-prime-end processing.

entities.name: Ssu72 sequence properties
observations: Length 262 aa; estimated molecular mass 29.31 kDa; theoretical pI 5.08.
The N-terminal segment includes a short disordered region; no separate cofactor requirement was reported in the retrieved annotation.
